Hi there. I'm John England, a data scientist and analyst based in Buffalo, NY. For the last three years I've been building data solutions that turn messy, hard-to-trust data into something people feel comfortable making decisions with.

I started in the weather world, studying atmospheric science, where I learned my first data tool: Python. I got the chance to apply it in a few roles and haven't looked back. Graduate school let me turn that passion for data into a profession, and since then I've been working in finance and banking, delivering data solutions and supporting data governance efforts.on and have been working in the Finance/banking domain delivering data solutions and supporting data governance efforts.
